html:
Ninh Binh – Ha Long 2 day, 1 night tour is the perfect journey for travelers who want to uncover the breathtaking natural beauty and rich cultural heritage of Northern Vietnam. Begin your adventure in Ninh Binh, home to spectacular limestone landscapes, historic temples, and peaceful river valleys. Continue to Ha Long Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, where towering islets, shimmering waters, and fascinating caves create one of the world’s most iconic seascapes.

ITINERARY

Day 1: Bai Dinh or Hoa Lu – Trang An or Tam Coc – Mua Cave

Meals Included: Lunch, Dinner

07:00 – 07:40 – Pick-up from Your Hotel

Your tour guide meets you at your hotel or homestay. Begin the 110–kilometer modern bus journey through the verdant countryside. A short break will be made en route.

Option 1: Bai Dinh Pagoda

10:00 – Visit Bai Dinh Pagoda Complex

Arrive at Bai Dinh, the largest pagoda complex in Vietnam and Southeast Asia. Situated at the foot of Dinh Mountain, it offers breathtaking views of river valleys and limestone karsts.

Highlights include:

  • 500 Arhat stone statues

  • Two giant bronze bells (27 tons and 36 tons)

  • The thousand–armed, thousand–eyed Quan Yin statue

  • The majestic Gautama Buddha statue

Option 2: Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

10:00 – Visit Hoa Lu Ancient Capital

Explore the historic capital of Vietnam, where you will visit Dinh King Temple and Le King Temple, both dating back to the seventeenth century.

12:00 – Lunch at a Local Restaurant

Enjoy a delicious Vietnamese meal featuring regional specialties.

Afternoon Choices

Option 1: Trang An Boat Trip

13:30 – Trang An Landscape Complex

Depart for the Trang An Grottoes, a UNESCO–recognized site renowned for majestic limestone mountains rising dramatically from rice fields.

Board a traditional sampan boat and glide through interconnected caves such as Lam Cave, Vang Cave, Dai Cave, and Thanh Truot Cave, along with stops at Cao Son Temple, Suoi Tien Temple, and Vu Lam Temple.

Option 2: Tam Coc Boat Trip

13:30 – Sampan Trip through Tam Coc

Enjoy a 1.5–hour boat excursion through Tam Coc, meaning “Three Caves.” Sail past limestone cliffs, caves, peaceful streams, rice paddies, and serene countryside views. Tam Coc is often called “Ha Long Bay on Land” and offers excellent opportunities for photography.

Mua Cave and Ngoa Long Mountain

15:30 – Visit Mua Cave

Begin the climb to the top of Ngoa Long Mountain and enjoy a panoramic view of the vast rice valley and dramatic limestone landscapes.

16:30 – Check-in at Homestay/Bungalow

Relax, swim, or unwind before dinner at 19:00. After dinner, enjoy the peaceful nighttime atmosphere at the poolside bar.

Note: The tour guide will not be present again until the following afternoon.

Day 2: Ninh Binh – Ha Long Sonata 5 Star Day Cruise – Hanoi

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch

Morning

Breakfast is served at the bungalow before check-out.

07:30 – Transfer to Ha Long Bay

Depart for Ha Long Bay.

11:45 – Arrival at Tuan Chau Island

Enter the private waiting lounge before boarding the Halong Sonata 5–Star Day Cruise. Begin your 6–hour journey on the iconic two–day sleeper boat route, famous for its uninhabited islets and spectacular limestone formations.

Buffet Lunch on Board

Enjoy a buffet lunch as the cruise glides through the stunning seascape.

Explore the Highlights of Ha Long Bay

14:00 – 16:30 – Bo Hon Archipelago

Visit the Surprising Cave (Sung Sot Cave), known for its impressive stalactites and stalagmites.

Continue to Luon Cave, where you may choose between kayaking or a bamboo boat ride through the tranquil lagoon.

Finally, visit Titov Island, where you may relax on the sandy beach or climb to the peak for a breathtaking panoramic view of Ha Long Bay.

Sunset Party on Board

16:30 – Sunset Party on the Cruise

Return to the ship and enjoy live traditional music, a jacuzzi, and time on the sun deck as the cruise returns to Tuan Chau Harbor.

Return to Hanoi

18:00 – Disembark & Transfer Back

Leave the cruise and board the bus for your return journey to Hanoi.

20:30 – 21:00 – Arrival in Hanoi

Your guide will drop you off at your hotel. The tour ends.

INCLUSION

  • Modern bus as per itinerary (complimentary bottled water on board)

  • Halong Sonata 5–Star Day Cruise with buffet lunch, live traditional music, jacuzzi

  • English–speaking guide as per itinerary

  • Meals: 2 lunches, 1 breakfast, 1 dinner

  • All entrance fees included in the itinerary

  • Accommodation in homestay or bungalow (twin or double sharing)

  • Cycling and swimming at the bungalow

EXCLUSION

  • Beverages, travel insurance

  • Kayaking or bamboo boat (5 United States Dollars per person, depending on floating house pricing)

  • Electric car in Bai Dinh Pagoda (5 United States Dollars per person)

  • Tour guide overnight at the bungalow

  • Tips and personal expenses

  • Children 5–8 years old: 75 percent of adult price

  • Children 9 years old and above: full adult price

  • Children under 5 years old: free of charge (excluding entrance fees, meals, and bus seat)

  • Single supplement

Note: Itinerary may change due to weather conditions.
outline: Day 1: Ninh Binh – Ha Long Bay – Hanoi
